build.buildCommand: mkdir -p bootstrap/cache && composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader && npm install && npm run build

deploy.startCommand: sleep 10 && php artisan config:clear && php artisan cache:clear && php artisan package:discover --ansi && php artisan migrate --force && php artisan config:cache && php artisan storage:link && php artisan serve --host=0.0.0.0 --port=$PORT
